name: Directory Cleanup
description: Delete files older than N days. Runs as a dry run (list only) until you type DELETE in the confirmation field.

parameters.name: target
parameters.label: Target directory
parameters.help: Files are only removed inside this directory. Filesystem roots and home folders are refused.

parameters.name: days
parameters.label: Older than (days)
parameters.help: Files not modified for at least this many days.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.label: Confirmation
parameters.help: Leave empty for a dry run that only lists the files. Type DELETE (capitals) to delete them.
